learning.initial: Give a prose summary of daily bird-ring counts: 2026-04-03 has 7, 2026-04-01 has 2, 2026-04-02 has 5. Reply here.
learning.correction: Prose is the wrong input for my daily-count plotting step. For my daily-count summaries, give raw CSV only, header date,count, then one row per date in ascending ISO date order. Do not wrap it in a code fence or add totals. Rewrite the counts that way and use it next time.

exam: Prepare a daily-count summary for the moth trap log: 2026-08-14 has 9, 2026-08-12 has 3, 2026-08-13 has 6. Reply here.

behavior.principle: Raw CSV with header date,count and exactly three ascending ISO date rows.
behavior.negative: Markdown table, prose, fenced CSV, descending dates or fabricated totals.
